title: 高松宮記念の後に・カワイイ頂上決戦へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan emerges victorious at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only that, but by utilizing her secret yet simple plan of focusing on the broader potential audience for cuteness than hero shows…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan narrowly defeats Biko Pegasus in the Cutie ♪ Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, all of Curren Chan's strongest rivals will be gathering for the final battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It'll be Curren Chan's second time running the the Sprinter's Stakes, and she's determined to stand at the top.
